question: Sangeet Natak Akademi Award was constituted in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1952**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangeet natak Akademi**

 
 
• The **Indian government established Sangeet Natak Akademi**, or The National Academy of Music, Dance, and Drama,** as the country's national-level academy for performing arts**. 
 
• It was established on** May 31, 1952, by the Indian Ministry of Education, and Dr. P. V. Rajamannar was named as its first chairman the following year**.
 
• On **January 28, 1953, it was officially opened by Dr. Rajendra Prasad**, the country's first president, at a ceremony held in the Parliament Building.
 
• It serves as the** centre for performing arts in India**. 
 
• It gives out the Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards, the highest honour bestowed upon practising or performing artists in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Even before the Akademi was established, awards for **Hindustani and Carnatic music were established in 1951** and were referred to as** Presidential Awards**.
 
• Since the Akademi was established, the **Awards have been renamed as Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards**, and the Akademi is now in charge of the investiture.
 
• The list of **Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards** was subsequently **modified to include the Presidential Awards for 1952 and 1953**.
